landing.title: Built on proof, not vibes.
landing.description: Relay's scoring engine is tested against a golden dataset of real lead scenarios: won deals, strong opportunities, bad-fit leads, restricted remote roles, hybrid roles, and on-site roles. Every new intelligence version must pass calibration before it is trusted in-product.
landing.trustLine: Benchmarked. Calibrated. Tested against real scenarios. Human-reviewed.
landing.disclaimer: Benchmarks are internal quality gates, not guarantees.
landing.finalCta: Relay does not just generate. It evaluates, calibrates, and proves before it ships.

app.description: Before V2 is used in production, it is tested against a golden dataset covering known wins, strong opportunities, bad prospects, and remote eligibility edge cases.
whatThisMeans: Relay is better at recognizing real-fit opportunities.
Remote eligibility is handled more carefully.
The system is tested before user-facing rollout.
app.warmExplanation: AI systems can sound confident even when they are wrong. Relay's benchmark exists to catch that before it reaches the user.
